mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or near the effective lower bound (0.1% or below) signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% signals deepening economic distress, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO and HOUST both decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 220), rising retail sales indicate resilient consumer demand that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220 and RSAFS rises (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts signal strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 signals an economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a deep recession with aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 200), rising industrial production signals robust economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 200 and INDPRO rises (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
